items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: At that time I was playing with Roy Eldridge out at Billy Berg's. Me, Roy Eldridge -- Roy had the group

ctx.x: This was in the '40's. '40. At that time I was playing with Roy Eldridge out at Billy Berg's. Me, Roy Eldridge -- Roy had the group -- Anita O'Day was singing with the group. And it's the only job I really ever worked with Roy, and the reason I worked that with him was we just came off a tour with Norman Granz Jazz at the Philharmonic. And he had a couple weeks out there. We worked it with him. Willie Willy Smith, Roy, myself, Wardell L. Gray, Jackie Mills on drums, Charlie Drayton on bass. He committed suicide…
